aboutPage.intro: Freelancing has given many professionals their independence. But businesses need comprehensive solutions that few experts can deliver alone. JUST ART brings together specialists from different fields to meet that need, with creative, management and training solutions.
aboutPage.story: JUST ART officially launched in 2025, after extensive reflection on the challenges designers face in gaining recognition in the market. Since digital presence is a key driver of business visibility, JUST ART leverages this reality to offer solutions tailored to entrepreneurs' needs.
aboutPage.modelIntro: JUST ART operates without fixed employees: a team assembled to fit each project.
